stories.title: Clubhouse Leader
stories.detail: Hang the banner for Anthony Parnell, 36 pts and best on ground by a very comfortable margin.

stories.title: Absolute Menace
stories.detail: 2 big ones on holes 13 & 14 - the rest of us should consider going home

stories.title: Logjam
stories.detail: 3 tied at the top on 36 - countback territory

stories.title: Three-Point Frenzy
stories.detail: 80 three-pointers across the field - the course is giving them up

stories.title: In the Hunt
stories.detail: 2nd - level with the lead

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Welcome to Wagga Wagga, Peter Hamblin from Young GC, and thanks for keeping it in play.

stories.title: Low-Marker Masterclass
stories.detail: Off the stick (5) and 7th - proper ball-striking

stories.title: Short-Hole Sniper
stories.detail: 3 threes on the par 3s - dialled in with the irons

stories.title: Reachable Feeling
stories.detail: 2 of the par 5s gave up 3-pointers - length is a weapon

stories.title: The Metronome
stories.detail: 7 holes in a row at 2 points or better - tick, tick, tick

stories.title: Short-Hole Assassin
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 3 of the par 3s - the short holes never stood a chance

stories.title: Finding a Rhythm
stories.detail: 3 twos on the bounce on holes 2, 3 & 4

stories.title: Spot Fires
stories.detail: 3 3-pointers+ scattered through the round - keeps finding ways to score

stories.title: Rollercoaster
stories.detail: 3 threes and 5 wipes - never a dull hole

stories.title: The Golf Tax Strikes Again
stories.detail: 3-pointer to 1-pointer on holes 3 & 4 - the course always takes its cut

stories.title: One Step Forward...
stories.detail: 3-pointer on hole 3, 1-pointer on hole 4

stories.title: Plot Hole
stories.detail: 2 wipes on holes 17 & 18 - the scorecard disagrees with the player

stories.title: Squeaky Clean
stories.detail: Zero wipes from 12 holes - not a wipe in sight

stories.title: Steady Eddie
stories.detail: 6 two-pointers, not a wipe in sight - metronomic golf

stories.title: One-Point Parade
stories.detail: 3 in a row on holes 18, 1 & 2 - sticking to the 1-point script

stories.title: The Full Experience
stories.detail: Hit every outcome on the card - the golf round as a show bag

stories.title: In the Wet
stories.detail: 2.8 soaked the lot of them and the scoreboard has the proof.
